podcast.title: Association with Los Iniciados
podcast.body: Alphaville was mentioned in connection with Los Iniciados, as it was supposed that members of Alphaville, a group that "coqueteó con lo oscuro" (flirted with the dark), were part of Servando Carballar's parallel project. "se supone que contaba conviembros de la banda alfabil, otro grupo que coqueteó con los curos."

srcs.episode: La España Siniestra ｜ La edad de oro del Postpunk y el Dark wave

podcast.title: Technopop Descendant
podcast.body: Listed as one of the artists who descended from the original Technopop scene. "There was Bronsky beat, aha, yellow, Elfaville, Frankie Ghost of Hollywood. They all descended from the original Tecno Pop scene."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
